note: The park's largest campground, in pine woods on the west shore of Emma Lake, separate from the Anglin Lake campgrounds; Heron's Hideaway and Coot's Corner hold its non-electric sites. Sites 124-136 on the east side sit about 60-70 m from the beach behind a band of conifers. ATV trails run through the park, though not in the campgrounds. --Claude

Not waterfront kept. Pin fine. Phone '' -> 1-306-982-6250.
